thematic_summaries.title: Divine Rest and Sanctification
thematic_summaries.summary: God establishes the seventh day as a sacred time of rest and completion. This demonstrates divine pattern of work and restoration, highlighting the theological significance of Sabbath rest and divine order.

thematic_summaries.title: Creation's Intentional Design
thematic_summaries.summary: The narrative reveals God's meticulous and purposeful creation, emphasizing divine intentionality in forming the natural world and human environment. Each element demonstrates deliberate planning and theological significance.

reevaluation.question: How does the divine rest in Genesis 2 reshape understanding of creation's purpose?
options: Reveals relational dynamics between Creator and creation
Provides model for human work-rest cycles

puzzle.question: Put yourself in the man's place, told you may eat freely from every tree of the garden but not from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. What would you weigh as you hear that in the day you eat of it you will surely die?

chain.summary: God finishes His work and rests on the seventh day (v. 2), and blesses that day and sanctifies it (v. 3). Exodus 20:8-11 says six days you labor, but the seventh is a Sabbath, because the LORD rested on it and set it apart as holy.
chain.question: How does Exodus 20:8-11 help you understand why God blessed and sanctified the seventh day?

conviction.because: the man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed
conviction.template: from today I bring my {feeling:shame, inadequacy} about {object:my past failures} into the light and instead of {behavior:hiding my true self}, I will {step:walk in His light}.
